text:
Sam: quick note from the design review — the help panel shows a little preview snippet when you hover the doc link, but the snippet uses 'route' while the docs header uses 'endpoint'. users in the test got tripped up. Jory (Docs): thanks Sam. which panel exactly? can you paste the path or a short clip? Sam: Console > APIGateway > Help panel (right). hover preview reads: 'Create a route to send traffic...' but doc heading is 'Create an endpoint'. Anika - Frontend: ah, that's our preview extractor using the first paragraph. if headings differ the slug mapping breaks too. easy fix: update the extractor to prefer the H1/H2 text and canonical term. Jory (Docs): proposal: canonicalize on 'endpoint' across UI + docs. also add a microcopy line in the preview: 'See docs for endpoint configuration' so the preview aligns. Bea (A11y): accessibility point: the hover preview is keyboard-inaccessible. keyboard users can't trigger the preview or read the snippet via screen reader. if we keep previews we need a focusable info button and aria-describedby that links to the preview text. Anika - Frontend: good catch. plan: replace hover-only tooltip with a focusable icon button next to the link. button will `aria-expanded` the preview panel and the preview will have `role="region" aria-labelledby` so SRs pick it up. small snippet: ```
...
``` When a user clicks the preview action and then clicks 'Open in docs' we will close the panel, update the hash and focus the target heading. Jory (Docs): i'll update the docs to add an alias note at the top: "Terminology: endpoint (aka route)" and add a docs-side canonical meta tag so the extractor can detect canonical term. Sam: can the preview also include a small deep-link icon that does a proper anchor jump (not just open top of page)? users expected that. Anika - Frontend: yes. deep-link will target the exact anchor id. decision needed: should it open in a new tab or same tab? Bea (A11y): same-tab is fine if we programmatically move focus to the heading and close the preview. if new tab is used, include aria-label "opens in new tab" and rel=noopener. for keyboard users ensure the preview button has a visible focus ring. Jory (Docs): i'll add anchor ids to the docs sections and add a short table of 'route->endpoint' mappings in the repo so infra can rewrite legacy anchors. Sam: can someone file a ticket with acceptance criteria: 1) preview is keyboard accessible; 2) preview text uses canonical term 'endpoint'; 3) add deep-link icon that jumps to anchor and manages focus; 4) docs alias line + canonical meta tag; 5) analytics event for preview open and anchor jump. Anika - Frontend: creating ticket DOCS-4120 now — will include unit test for aria-expanded behavior and e2e for anchor deep-link & focus. docs-bot: created DOCS-4120: "Help preview accessibility + terminology canonicalization" assigned to Anika - Frontend, due in 8 days. Jory (Docs): thanks all — i'll push the alias and canonical meta PR and share the mapping spreadsheet. Sam: great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
